verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a dedicated structured outputs feature that constrains responses to a specific schema so output is valid and parseable, plus strict tool use (`strict: true`) that guarantees schema validation on tool inputs. The docs also frame this as getting 'validated JSON results', and the SDKs advertise type safety, so code can consume output without fragile parsing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence of SDK-native typed parsing helpers (e.g. schema-to-class binding), and documentation of supported schema features, limitations or per-model availability.
